name: 4.6 Continuous Distribution - Lab
_note: Built 2026-08-11. All ten authored fresh (lab kind): q10-uniform-theoretical, q11-uniform-quartiles-theoretical, q12-pilot-median-quartiles, q13-pilot-mean, q14-pilot-sd, q15-bar-widths, q16-fences, q17-compare-pilot, q18-500-vs-50, pre-frq-grade-a-uniform-lab-comparison. Points 10x10 = 100. BookSHelf 4.6 is a lab: generate 50 values from U(0,1), compare empirical to theoretical. The MOM assignment checks the theoretical half (fixed: mu=0.5, sigma~0.2887, Q1=0.25, median=0.5, Q3=0.75, fences -0.5/1.5) and gives the section's own 12-value pilot dataset (0.0412..0.9564) for the empirical half, so every answer is deterministic. Lab settings per reference/intro-stats-assessment-settings.md: 3 attempts x 20 versions, no penalty, no early-finish bonus, GROUP gradebook category, 2 late passes, no time limit. Pre-FRQ is authored-first (no lab FRQ to mirror): categories State the Theoretical Value (3) / State the Empirical Value (3) / Compare and Explain the Gap (4), dropped category STATE THE THEORETICAL VALUE — deliberately the same as the 4.4 lab pre-FRQ's dropped category, because the two labs are a matched pair teaching the same empirical-vs-theoretical lesson.
